description: Electronic components from manufacturer and supplier BMEcat catalogues: identity by normalised manufacturer and MPN as published, distributor SKUs as provider-scoped aliases, parametric attributes with tolerances, lifecycle status only as a named source published it, reviewable manufacturer links and link-only records for Octopart and DigiKey. Records, lifecycle statuses and manufacturer links stay in the one Products store (products.core). No cross-reference, replacement, price, stock or availability.

semantic_constraints.identity: normalised manufacturer + MPN as published; SKUs are provider-scoped aliases, never identity
semantic_constraints.lifecycle: stored only as a named source published it, with its date; never inferred from dates, absence or successors
semantic_constraints.sources: implement: BMEcat catalogues whose terms permit reuse; link-only: Octopart and DigiKey (nothing fetched or cached); not implemented: Mouser and crawling
semantic_constraints.manufacturers: names are one manufacturer when their normalised names agree or reviewed identity decisions link them to one canonical entity
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no cross-reference or drop-in replacement suggestions, prices, stock or availability
